title: Autonomous IQA Evolution
blurb: A 65-minute unattended loop on an RTX 5090: ComfyUI renders a frame, PIL scores its sharpness/colorfulness/brightness, a local vision LLM judges it out of 100 and rewrites the prompt, and the cycle repeats. Sixteen generations drift from a stained-glass mosaic seed to a 95/100 mandala ceiling, surviving four mid-run GPU timeouts along the way.

thumb.alt: A stained-glass mosaic prompt evolving generation by generation into a vibrant mandala ceiling, the top-scoring candidate
